status: Coming soon to the App Store
intro: EpistleChat is an end-to-end encrypted messenger for iPhone that makes talking to your people feel personal again: chats full of personality, letters worth keeping, and communities you'll want to spend time in.
waitlist_text: Drop your email and we'll ping you the moment EpistleChat is ready to pre-download on the App Store.
letters_intro: Write a real letter. Choose the stationery, handwriting, ink, wax seal and bouquet, then pick how it arrives.

styles.name: Classic Letter
styles.text: The seal cracks and the page unfolds.

styles.name: Royal Scroll
styles.text: A fanfare plays and the parchment unrolls.

styles.name: Message in a Bottle
styles.text: It washes ashore and the cork pops.

styles.name: Paper Plane
styles.text: It loops in and lands at their feet.

styles.name: Time Capsule
styles.text: Sealed until the day you choose.

styles.name: Museum
styles.text: Your words, framed and exhibited like art.

letter_extras.title: Open when…
letter_extras.text: Letters for when you miss me, when you can't sleep, or on your birthday.

letter_extras.title: Scented letters
letter_extras.text: Add a scent to set the mood before they read a word.

letter_extras.title: Bouquets with meaning
letter_extras.text: Every flower in the bouquet says something.

letter_extras.title: Delivered by Pip
letter_extras.text: Let Pip the capybara carry it by paper plane or by slow boat.

letter_extras.title: Keepsakes
letter_extras.text: Letters you receive are saved, so the important words stay.

chat_intro: Everyday messages, with the fun turned back on.

features.title: Message effects
features.text: Confetti, Fire, Ice, Disco, Invisible Ink, or wrapped as a Present.

features.title: Draw together
features.text: Doodle with each other right on the chat background.

features.title: Voice, photos & polls
features.text: Voice messages, photos, polls, reactions and @mentions.

features.title: Your own stickers
features.text: Make your own stickers and emoji.

features.title: Themes & wallpapers
features.text: Pick a chat theme, or use your own photo as the wallpaper.

features.title: On-device translation
features.text: Read messages and letters in your own language, translated right on your phone.

groups.title: Plan things together
groups.text: Stop the endless "so when are we meeting?" thread.
points: Decision cards find a time that works for the group
Vote in order of preference, or rule options out
Split a bill, right in the chat

groups.title: Messages that respect your time
groups.text: Reach people without stressing them out.
points: Send for "Later": it waits until their quiet hours are over
Mark something urgent when it really matters
Soft read receipts that don't put pressure on anyone

groups.title: Communities & Lounges
groups.text: Places you'll actually want to hang out.
points: Start from a template: Hangout, Gaming, Study Hall, Creators, Book Club
Voice lounges in animated rooms: a campfire, a café, outer space, a rainy window
Host a Stage where the audience raises a hand to speak
Add bots to keep things running

groups.title: Be yourself
groups.text: A profile that actually feels like you.
points: Animated avatar decorations and profile frames
Styled display names with custom fonts and gradients
Pocket Notes: a short status that fades after 24 hours
Link Spotify, Steam, PlayStation, AniList, Twitch and more
Show as Active, Sleep, Do Not Disturb, or appear offline

groups.title: Private by design
points: End-to-end encrypted messages, photos, voice notes and files
Your encryption keys stay on your device
Screenshot alerts, and chats hidden in the app switcher
Face ID lock and two-factor sign-in
Teen accounts with safer defaults
No ads, and your data is never sold

membership_text: EpistleChat is free. Memberships unlock extra cosmetics and bigger limits.
